title: Modular Inverse
prompt:
Find the modular inverse of 23 modulo 31
(the x in [0, 31) with 23*x ≡ 1 (mod 31)).
hint: use the extended Euclidean algorithm; enter one integer in [0, m)
recap: The modular inverse of a (mod m) is the x with a·x ≡ 1 (mod m). It exists iff gcd(a, m) = 1; the extended Euclidean algorithm finds it.
